In this paper, we propose Self-Prompting LLMs for Zero-Shot Open-Domain Question Answering. Our method induces the LLM to generate pseudo QA pairs with matching passages and explanations and use them for in-context learning.

Since the performance of large language models on ODQA is highly underestimated with EM and F1 , we also report the Instruct-Eval (IE)  score with GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023a) (gpt-4-1106-preview) as the evaluator model.
